description: Immutable seeded single-octave three-coordinate gradient field with pure binary64 samples in[0,1]; independent of Processing noise.

seed.evidence: Required repeatability is a design capability; the motivating note does not establish a portable seed algorithm or preferred seed.

x.evidence: pelosNoise2 depth slice and conitos volume lookup; explicit caller coordinates; safe-corner bounds are representability, not recommended ranges.

y.evidence: pelosNoise2 depth slice and conitos volume lookup; explicit caller coordinates; safe-corner bounds are representability, not recommended ranges.

z.evidence: pelosNoise2 depth slice and conitos volume lookup; explicit caller coordinates; safe-corner bounds are representability, not recommended ranges.

behavior.identity: Required uint32 seed, immutable detached serialization; pure x/y/z queries with no global state or sample consumption.
behavior.numerics: Exact binary64 safe-corner subtraction, three-stage lowbias32 corner hash, twelve integer gradients, quintic fades and x-then-y-then-z interpolation; clamp output0..1. See normative document for exact order.
behavior.native: GradientNoise3D01.create(Object) or create(long); serialize; sample(Object tuple), sample(Object,Object,Object), sample(double,double,double); only six standard boxed numeric carriers.
behavior.complexity: O(1) storage and eight-corner work per sample; scalar hot path allocation-free.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Wrong constructor shape, unknown/missing key, bool/nonfinite/noninteger seed, or seed outside unsigned32.
errors.INVALID_QUERY: Query not exactly three finite supported numbers, or a coordinate outside the safe-corner domain.

processing-java.delivery_scope: Java first; implementation and native review pending.

reproduction.acceptance: Explicit-depth planar edits and native3D mesh transfer; private study is design evidence only. No source replay or other target claim.

review.status: Approved exact semantics for implementation; core/native/distribution acceptance pending.

algorithm_sources.relationship: Gradient interpolation and quintic fade concept; no reference code or permutation copied.
